references.text: The dimensions of the mercy seat correspond to those of the ark: two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
The mercy seat was to be placed on top of the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
The mercy seat (כַפֹּרֶת) is positioned above the testimony, where God meets with Moses.
The mercy seat is mentioned as part of what was to be made for the tabernacle.
The mercy seat is mentioned together with the ark and the veil in connection with the gathering of materials.
Bezalel made the mercy seat from pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide, exactly as described here.
Moses placed the mercy seat on top of the ark when the tabernacle was set up.
The mercy seat is the place where God reveals himself in the cloud above the ark.
On the Day of Atonement, the high priest sprinkled blood on and before the mercy seat to make atonement.
God spoke to Moses from the mercy seat between the two cherubim.
David gave Solomon the design for the mercy seat (בֵּית הַכַפֹּרֶת) in the temple plans.
The book of Hebrews mentions the cherubim that overshadowed the mercy seat (τὸ ἱλαστήριον) in its description of the tabernacle furnishings.
Paul uses the term ἱλαστήριον (mercy seat/propitiation) to refer to Christ, who fulfills what the mercy seat symbolized.
